# eimzo-ts

> Unofficial, dependency-free TypeScript client that lets a web page use E-IMZO, the desktop application for electronic digital signatures in Uzbekistan: list the user's keys, create PKCS#7 (CMS) signatures, and log users in by digital signature. Runs in the browser; signature verification is done on the server by e-imzo-server.

Key facts:

- Install: `npm install eimzo-ts`. ESM, CJS and an IIFE build (global `EimzoClient`), TypeScript declarations included.
- Entry point: `createEimzo(options)` returns a client with `listKeys`, `listDevices`, `loadKey`, `sign`, `signFile`, `login`, `signDocument`, `unloadKey`, `call`.
- Connects to E-IMZO at `ws://127.0.0.1:64646` (http pages) or `wss://127.0.0.1:64443` (https pages).
- Errors are `EimzoError` with a `code` such as `NOT_INSTALLED`, `API_KEY_REJECTED`, `WRONG_PASSWORD`, `CANCELLED`.
- Create one client per app; call it only in browser code (not during SSR).
- Not for: signature verification, mobile signing (ID-CARD E-IMZO MOBILE), UI components.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://abduazimkhuja.github.io/eimzo-ts/): what it is, install, quick start, compatibility
- [Login with a digital signature](https://abduazimkhuja.github.io/eimzo-ts/login/): challenge flow, backend endpoints, /backend/auth statuses
- [Signing documents and files](https://abduazimkhuja.github.io/eimzo-ts/sign/): attached vs detached PKCS#7, timestamps, server checks
- [API reference](https://abduazimkhuja.github.io/eimzo-ts/api/): options, methods, createFetchBackend, error codes
- [FAQ](https://abduazimkhuja.github.io/eimzo-ts/faq/): when to use and not to use, HTTPS, API keys, SSR, testing, alternatives
- [Troubleshooting](https://abduazimkhuja.github.io/eimzo-ts/troubleshooting/): every error code with causes and fixes
